name: Kuwait

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, white and red, with a black trapezoid at the hoist whose shorter side faces the fly.
flag.symbolism: The colors come from a poem by Safi al-Din al-Hilli: white for good deeds, black for battles, green for fertile land and red for the blood on swords.

hook: Kuwait's hoist is a black trapezoid, a triangle with its tip cut off; Jordan and Palestine have red triangles and the UAE a red bar.
trivia: The flag was first raised on 24 November 1961, a few months after independence from Britain.
The Kuwaiti dinar is the highest-valued currency unit in the world.
